'''Kobans''' were the [[Human/Legends|Human]] inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Koba]]. They were enslaved by the [[Advozse/Legends|Advozsec]] warlord [[Tulak]]. The planet and its people were freed when [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]] defeated [[Kalut]].

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Kobans are incorrectly named Kodans in ''[[Jedi Quest: The Shadow Trap]]''.
